test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following can lead to sustainable management of forest resources?

options.text: Adjusting the harvest of wood depending on the rate of growth of forests
Making forests off-limits to human beings and their livestock
Using money from safari tourists to protect forests from logging
Applying fertilisers and growth promoters to enhance the growth of trees

solution:
The correct answer is __**Adjusting the harvest of wood depending on the rate of growth of forests**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Sustainable Yield Management**: Adjusting the harvest of wood based on the natural growth rate of forests ensures that the extraction does not exceed the regeneration capacity, promoting long-term forest health.
